title: bug-reaper
description: An evidence-based Web2 bug bounty agent skill covering 18 vulnerability classes across HackerOne, Bugcrowd, Intigriti, and YesWeHack. Built to report only confirmed, triage-ready findings — no AI slop.

title: Keyana
description: A high-performance JavaScript reconnaissance tool in Go. Matches 856+ secret patterns with the Aho-Corasick algorithm, scans 633 files in under five seconds, and beautifies minified bundles automatically.

title: APIVulnMiner
description: An asynchronous API vulnerability scanner with AI-assisted endpoint discovery, comprehensive OWASP Top 10 testing, and detailed reporting. Built to run in CI or standalone from a container.

title: AuthGen
description: A Python GUI application for generating, storing, and managing time-based authentication keys with customisable durations, backed by SQLite and the secrets module.

title: LockPickPDF
description: A PyQt6 tool that brute-forces password-protected PDFs from a supplied wordlist, wrapping the qpdf library with progress reporting and graceful cancellation.

title: PassGuard
description: A PyQt6 tool that scores password strength against length and character-class criteria, and generates cryptographically strong replacements.

title: GeoCipher
description: A PyQt6 OSINT utility that resolves geographical information from IP addresses or latitude/longitude pairs through external APIs, with structured result export.

title: SolutiiAI
description: An SEO-optimised Next.js website integrating custom AI solutions, including intelligent chatbots and voice agents for customer interaction.

title: Pixleon
description: A desktop suite for image and video work: background removal, format conversion, compression, and resizing, wrapping rembg, Pillow, and FFmpeg behind one interface.

title: QuoteGen
description: A PyQt6 application serving random quotes from a large SQLite corpus, with translation, text-to-speech, clipboard export, and display customisation.

title: QR Master
description: A PyQt6 application for generating customised QR codes from text or links, with PNG export and styling controls.
